trans-unit.target: The word the page listing the books goes by ("Our stories", "Our albums"). Left empty, it keeps the bundle’s own.
Drops a burst of confetti when a book's page opens. Nothing fires for a visitor who asked for reduced motion.
Added to the books' Google Play addresses, so the sales coming from the site are credited to you. Left empty, an address opens exactly as it is stored

The publisher's own ISBN roots, one per line and with their hyphens, e.g. “978-2-488750”. Where an ISBN is cut is not deducible from the number: it comes from the official ranges of the International ISBN Agency. A number starting with none of the declared roots is printed with no hyphen at all.
Shows the readers' score on the page of a book, of a serie and of a strip, and on every card of the book and strip listings. The icon and the scale are UiBundle's own settings.
First segment of a book's url, e.g. "book" for /book/my-title. Left empty, the page is not served at all.

Letter of the short link a book is shared with, e.g. "b" for /b3, the number being the book's own. Handy on a social network, where a short address is read and typed. Left empty, no such url is served.

First segment of the url listing the books, e.g. "books" for /books. The change applies straight away, but the former urls return a not-found page: set up a redirect if they are indexed. Left empty, the page is not served at all — which is what a site whose books are read under its own addresses sets here.

First segment of the url listing the catalog categories, e.g. "categories", and of each category's own page below it (/categories/novels). Left empty, the pages are not served: the categories still read on the book pages, as plain keywords.
First segment of each author's or illustrator's own page, e.g. "author" (/author/their-name). Left empty, the pages are not served at all.
First segment of the url listing the authors and illustrators, e.g. "authors". Left empty, the list is not served at all.
First segment of the url listing the book series, e.g. "series", and of each serie's own page below it (/series/my-serie). Left empty, the pages are not served at all.
First segment of a strip's url, e.g. "strip" for /strip/my-strip. Left empty, the page is not served at all.
Letter of the short link a strip is shared with, e.g. "s" for /s3, the number being the strip's own. Left empty, no such url is served.

First segment of the url listing the strip series, e.g. "strips", and of each serie's own page below it (/strips/my-serie). A strip is read inside its serie, never here. Left empty, the pages are not served at all.
What a strip's card shows in the listing: "image" its drawing, "text" its summary, "both" of them.
The file of the mark set on a strip's card, e.g. "logo.webp". Empty, the card carries none.
The icon a strip is rated with, when it has to differ from the rest of the site's. Empty, the strip follows the general setting.
